notes.title: CCC - Patch 5
notes.content:
*BUG FIX: The passive auto purchase did not save properly.
*Increased auto clicker max cps from 20 to 25.
*Upgrades that are upgraded to the maximum will now display “MAX,” and will no longer be able to be purchased.

notes.title: CCC - Patch 4
notes.content:
*Added auto purchase for active and passive upgrade. 
*Added a highlight over the upgrade that is currently selected for auto purchase.
*Added a button inside settings that takes you to the Google Play Store.
*BUG FIX: The cps on auto clicker would not work properly after 5+ cps.
*BUG FIX: Using an auto clicker on falling cursors could cause a falling cursor to break more than once, resulting in more click gold.
*BUG FIX: This was the weirdest bug I’ve ever encountered. 3 different players reported this bug. After ascending, the active price would be set to 594343 and the passive to 234.5^3. This price would be stuck and not change, resulting in a “softlock.” Well let’s just say that after hours of trying to fix it, all I needed to do was to change 2 lines of code.

notes.title: CCC - Patch 3
notes.content:
*BUG FIX: Fixed a bug where the ball would only bounce around on the corners.
*The game now saves the 1X, 10X, 25X or MAX purchase amount between plays.

notes.title: CCC - Patch 2
notes.content:
*BUG FIX: The second ball would not spawn on game startup if the “Bounce the ball 10000 times” achievement is completed. I also made it so that the 2 bouncy balls cannot follow eachother, instead they always move in different directions.
*BUG FIX: The fist reward timer would last slightly longer than it’s supposed to, resulting in issues if you have the golden fist spawn time set down to 27 seconds.
*BUG FIX: Issues with falling cursor tier 3+ not breaking after a certain amount of clicks.
*BUG FIX: Auto purchase would not work if 10X or 25X is selected. The "CANT AFFORD SOUND EFFECT" would also continuously play.
*I forgot to add the percent icon onto the auto purchase crit chance icon. You can now identify which is which.

notes.title: CCC - Patch 1
notes.content:
*You can now choose what to auto purchase.
*The game window can now be re-sized.
*Potential bug fix: The game checks on startup if an achievement has been triggered in-game but not in steam, this should trigger the correct achievement.
